identity.title: A Multiline Study of a High-mass Young Stellar Object in the Small Magellanic Cloud with ALMA: The Detection of Methanol Gas at 0.2 Solar Metallicity

paper_type_evidence.quote: We report the results of subparsec-scale submillimeter observations towards an embedded high-mass young stellar object in the Small Magellanic Cloud (SMC) with ALMA.

question.value: What are the physical and chemical properties of dense cores around a high-mass YSO in the SMC, and is CH3OH gas present at 0.2 solar metallicity?

evidence.quote: The first detection of CH$_3$OH in the SMC has a strong impact on our understanding of the formation of complex organic molecules in metal-poor environments.
Observations were carried out with ALMA in November 2016 as a part of the Cycle 4 program 2016.1.00394.S (PI T. Shimonishi).
The target was observed in Band 6 with four spectral windows

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: 4 spectral windows: 241.48–243.36, 243.84–245.71, 256.99–258.87, 258.85–260.72 GHz; 977 kHz resolution before averaging

evidence.quote: covering 241.48–243.36, 243.84-245.71, 256.99–258.87, and 258.85–260.72 GHz in the rest-frame frequency. The frequency resolution is 977 kHz before channel averaging.
HDS ($1_{0,1}-0_{0,0}$), which is located at 244.55558 GHz and has the upper-state energy of 11.7 K according to the CDMS catalogue
In total 43 antennas are used for the observations with the minimum and maximum baseline length of 19 m and 1.1 km.
The synthesized beam size is 0.35–0.37$\ensuremath{''}$ $\times$ 0.22–0.23$\ensuremath{''}$ with a position angle of -25 degree
the maximum recoverable angular scale is about 3$\ensuremath{''}$
The total on-source integration time is 39 minutes.

analysis_steps.goal: Extract spectra and continuum at three positions

method.value: Single Gaussian fits with optional polynomial local baseline; direct integration for two narrow CH3OH lines; 3 sigma detection criterion

evidence.quote: Line parameters are measured by fitting a single Gaussian profile to observed lines.
The detection criteria adopted here are the 3$\sigma$ significance level

method.value: Rotation diagram under optically thin LTE, straight-line fit, spectroscopy from CDMS

evidence.quote: An optically thin condition and the local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE) are assumed here.

fitting.value: Straight-line fit in the rotation diagram; marginal detections and upper limits included

evidence.quote: the data points for two marginal CH$_3$OH detections (5$_{0}$–4$_{0}$ E and 5$_{\pm2}$–4$_{\pm2}$ E, $Eu$ = 48 K and 61 K) are included in the straight-line fit for P2.

results_numeric.quantity: Gas mass YSO core / East core

evidence.quote: about 80 M$_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$ for the YSO core and about 50 M$_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$ for the East core
The bolometric luminosity of the YSO is estimated to be 2 $\times$ 10$^4$ L$_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$ by integrating the SED from 1 $\mu$m to 1200 $\mu$m.

findings_qualitative.value: CH3OH, SO2, H2CS, C33S and H13CN detected for the first time in the SMC

evidence.quote: CH$_3$OH, SO$_2$, H$_2$CS, C$^{33}$S, and H$^{13}$CN are for the first time detected in the SMC.

claims.hypothesis: Is CH3OH gas present in a low-metallicity SMC dense core, and at what temperature?
claims.experiment: Band 6 ALMA lines with CH3OH rotation diagram
claims.result: Multiple CH3OH lines detected at P2, P3 with Trot ~12–13 K
claims.finding: CH3OH gas detected in SMC; cold gas ~10 K

evidence.quote: The gas temperature is estimated to be $\sim$10 K based on the rotation analysis of CH$_3$OH lines.

claims.hypothesis: Is CH3OH gas abundance reduced at 0.2 solar metallicity?
claims.experiment: Compare East core abundances with Galactic cold sources
claims.finding: No metallicity-scaled depletion of CH3OH in East core

evidence.quote: comparable with or marginally higher than those of similar cold sources in our Galaxy despite a factor of five lower metallicity in the SMC

claims.hypothesis: Are the YSO core and East core chemically distinct?
claims.experiment: Compare abundances at P1, P2, P3
claims.result: CS, H2CS, SiO underabundant at P1; P2 and P3 correlated (r=0.89)

evidence.quote: These results imply a chemical differentiation between the YSO core and the East core.

limitations_admitted.value: Warm gas components (>=50 K) cannot be ruled out given limited frequency coverage

evidence.quote: the presence of warm gas components ($\gtrsim$50 K) within the core can not be ruled out from the limited frequency coverage of the present observations.

limitations_admitted.value: Abundances carry systematic uncertainty from assumed dust temperature

evidence.quote: derived molecular abundances entail the systematic uncertainty depending on the assumption of dust temperatures

referee_caveats_inferred: Dust temperature set equal to CH3OH Trot; abundance depends strongly on it
Rotation diagram with few lines, marginal detections and large uncertainties
Single source, so generality to SMC is unclear
LTE and optically thin assumptions untested
